name: UTEP Mining Engineering Summer Camp
org: Miguel A. Loya College of Engineering, UTEP
what_you_do: Tour a real foundry and a working mine. Try lab demos in metals and rocks. Stay in UTEP dorms.
who_can_apply: High school students going into 10th, 11th or 12th grade. You should like STEM jobs and mining engineering.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The 2026 camps ran June 21 to 23, June 24 to 26 and June 28 to 30. Use the Get Notified button on the program page for future camps.
how_to_apply: The program page has a Get Notified for Future Camps option. Email miningengineering@utep.edu. Or call 915-747-7057.
notes: No 2027 dates are posted on the program page.
